item.title: Hegseth's failed impeachment was a warning to Democrats. Where will they go from here?
item.description: Democrats have been given a huge opportunity with majorities in both the House and Senate — but the balance of priorities, timing, messaging and discipline are all going to be major tests.

item.title: As Democrats win big, thirst traps of male candidates take social media by storm
item.description: It's everywhere on social media: Democrats celebrating the attractive men voters elected in the midterms. But it's bigger than a meme and says a lot about politics of masculinity in the age of Trump.

item.title: Democrat Jonathan Kreiss-Tomkins wins race for Alaska governor, replaces a Republican
item.description: Kreiss-Tomkins, a former state legislator, ran a campaign emphasizing bipartisanship in the the state that usually votes Republican. At 37, he'll be the youngest governor in the state's history.

item.title: What we know about the FAA nationwide ground stop
item.description: The Federal Aviation Administration took an extraordinary step Friday afternoon by issuing a nationwide ground stop. No planes are taking off at any airport and millions of passengers are stranded.

item.title: The government says it will close a beloved D.C. park Sunday. Will a judge step in?
item.description: Federal judge Ana Reyes grilled the government on Friday about its plans for East Potomac Park, and indicated she could order it to remain open despite President Trump's renovation wishes.

item.title: USMNT head coach Mauricio Pochettino is leaving for Manchester United
item.description: Mauricio Pochettino is out as head coach of the U.S. men's national soccer team. Pochettino led the U.S. to the round of 16 at last year's World Cup. He's departing to coach Manchester United.
